```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
detect_sensors : detect sensors
no_sensors : no sensors detected
sensors_ok : sensors detected
e_and_h_active : E and H active
contd_e : continue with E
contd_h : continue with E & H <br> detected channels
load_template : load template
template_loaded : template loaded
e_active : E active
e_only : E (EMAP) <br> or current clamps, <br> +/- 2.5 V
[*] --> boot
boot --> detect_sensors
detect_sensors --> no_sensors
detect_sensors --> sensors_ok
sensors_ok --> e_and_h_active
no_sensors --> e_active
e_active --> contd_e
e_active --> load_template
e_and_h_active --> contd_h
e_and_h_active --> load_template
load_template --> template_loaded
contd_e --> e_only

```
configuration logic for ADU-12e

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    %% Define two separate start nodes
    AD1([AD1]) --> CH1[Ch: 0 1 2 5 <br> Ex Ey Hx Hx_2]
    AD2([AD2]) --> CH2[Ch: 3 4 6 7 <br> Hy Hz Hy_2 Hz_2]

    %% Connect to intermediate or final steps
   %% CH1 --> MP{MP}
   %% CH2 --> MP
   %% CH1 --> Merge{Merge}
   %% CH2 --> Merge
```
| ADU Channel | A/D Channel | ADC-Channel | Name |
|-------------|-------------|-------------|------|
| 0           | 0           | 0           | Ex   |
| 1           | 0           | 1           | Ey   |
| 2           | 0           | 2           | Hx   |
| 5           | 0           | 3           | MP-0|
| 3           | 1           | 0           | Hy   |
| 4           | 1           | 1           | Hz   |
| 6           | 1           | 2           | MP-1|
| 7           | 1           | 3           | MP-2|

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
      [*] --> Off
      Off --> Green : plugged
      Green --> Yellow : mount
      Yellow --> Red : writing
      Red --> Green : finished
      Red --> Yellow : wait write (job)
      Green --> Off : unplugged

      style Green fill:#348017,color:white
      style Yellow fill:#FFD700
      style Red fill:#FF0000

```
green: you can unplug the device

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
    direction LR
    [*] --> jobs
    booting --> selftest: boot
    selftest --> missing: do_nothing
    selftest --> running: set_long
    running --> selftest: boot
```

booting selftest missing

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
    short_selftest --> running: boot
    running --> short_selftest: do_nothing
    running --> long_selftest: set_long
    long_selftest --> running: boot

```

the system measures the contact resistance with ± 5% accuracy
0 Ω may appear ~0.1 Ω and open channels ~4.8 MΩ (or 11.8 MΩ for the line)

max gain is 8; a higher gain may cause saturation when a) peaks occur or b) when there is a drift in the signal of the electrodes.

Probe Resistance <5kOhm  Radio Filter strong
Probe Resistance >=5kOhm  Radio Filter weak
~2.5MB/s WiFi transfer rate
WiFi range ~10m indoors, ~30m outdoors, access point mode recommended and encryption WPA2 enabled
